articles.author: The Associated Press
articles.title: Australian judge rejects prisoner's human rights challenge to Vegemite ban - NPR
articles.description: Andre McKechnie, 55, is serving a life sentence for murder. He took his battle for the salty, sticky, black-brown byproduct of brewing beer to the court last year. He argued being refused Vegemite breached the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act.
articles.content: MELBOURNE, Australia A prisoner on Monday lost his challenge to an Australian state's ban on inmates eating Vegemite after he argued in court that withholding the polarizing yeast-based spread breach… [+4762 chars]
